channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Verizon’s CEO turned down the job several times before leaving retirement on his ranch: ‘I came in with a little bit of a bad attitude’
item.description: Dan Schulman was happy tending cattle in Montana. But Verizon's struggles and a push from his wife convinced him to return to the corner office.

item.title: Lockheed Martin’s CEO flew 5,000+ hours as an Air Force pilot and Casey’s CEO fought in the Gulf War—now they’re running Fortune 500 companies
item.description: From the battlefield to the boardroom, these Fortune 500 CEOs say their military service taught them lessons that continue to shape how they lead.

item.title: Nvidia board’s idolatry of Jensen Huang could open the door to shareholder lawsuits in Delaware Chancery Court
item.description: If they never asked him, that is the Caremark problem.

item.title: Silicon Valley’s richest outspent supporters more than 10 to one to kill California’s billionaire tax—and won
item.description: Voters also voted to pass Proposition 42, potentially blocking future taxes on income and assets.
